feature: Native capability refresh and executable platform contracts

scenarios.name: Keep native Mac engine choices current while language checks overlap
scenarios.given: the engine menu has verified choices for an earlier language and a newer native capability check is pending
scenarios.when: the language changes before or during a check, a previous check completes late, or a retained menu action is selected
scenarios.then: old choices are removed while checking, cancelled or superseded results cannot restore them, and a stale action preserves the current saved engine

scenarios.name: Run native Mac and Watch contracts against their own targets
scenarios.given: the catalog binds native Mac and Watch unit or UI methods
scenarios.when: a developer runs their BDD suite or full local validation
scenarios.then: the matching native platform target executes exact selectors on an explicit dedicated Watch simulator ID; missing/wrong Watch destinations, zero tests, skipped tests or unrelated passing methods cannot satisfy the contract

scenarios.name: Explain denied local capture and offline remote before recording
scenarios.given: the Watch microphone is denied or local battery/storage is insufficient, or the paired phone is offline or cannot transcribe
scenarios.when: native recording controls refresh and a local or remote Start action is attempted
scenarios.then: local recording refuses permission/capture work with recovery, remote Start sends no message until the phone is ready, and reachable Stop remains usable without queued commands
